name: singlet_communication_lr_resource_curation
title: Harmonise ligand-receptor resources
description: Builds one directed, complex-aware ligand-receptor table from pinned resource snapshots, with per-row resource counts and provenance, and writes it to uns/lr_resource. Use once per species and snapshot, before any communication scoring. It reads no expression matrix and tests no communication, so do not use it to score interactions.

dataset.description: Handle of the .singlet dataset that receives uns/lr_resource. Expression is not read.

species.description: Organism of the output table; mus_musculus maps human rows through orthology.

resources.description: Resources to combine. consensus must be used alone, since it already contains its constituents.

min_resources.description: Keep pairs supported by at least this many resources; 1 keeps the full union with counts.

snapshot.description: Pinned snapshot identifier, commit or file hash, recorded in metadata. Always set it for comparable outputs.

restrict_to_features.description: Keep only pairs whose subunits appear in var/feature_symbol of the dataset.

orthology.description: Used only when species is mus_musculus.

min_evidence.description: Minimum number of HCOP sources supporting an orthologue.

one_to_many.description: Maximum orthologues per subunit; subunits with more are treated as missing.

device.description: Always cpu; table operations have no GPU path.

dry_run.description: Return the estimate and row counts without writing.

overwrite.description: Replace existing uns/lr_resource and metadata instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: wrote uns/lr_resource; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Completed runs: n_pairs_ordered, n_pairs_unordered, n_complex_rows, n_resources_histogram, dropped_below_min_resources, snapshot, table_sha256, orthology_dropped (mouse only).

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
